new_value: Rewrote all three header docs in lichen/subsys/lichen/oscore/include/lichen/oscore.h to mirror _with_piv completeness. protect_response: now documents RFC 8613 8.3 no-PIV mode (empty OSCORE option, request-nonce reuse, no SSN consumption), canonical request_piv requirement (1..5 bytes; request_piv_len==0/NULL is INVALID_PARAM - the old len==0 acceptance is called out as removed), response-class 2..5 requirement, duplicate-correlation REPLAY (once per request PIV, CONFIG_LICHEN_OSCORE_REPLAY_WINDOW deep), and the zero-caller-bytes guarantee (encrypt is the only writer of caller buffers). Caller audit (as required): lichen_coap_oscore_respond (coap_oscore.c:302-316) and coap_oscore_respond_resource fall back to an UNPROTECTED, EMPTY 5.00 INTERNAL_ERROR on any protect failure; decision documented in the header: this fallback is acceptable because the unprotected error carries no application payload (nothing protected degrades), so piv_len==0 caller contract violations surface only as the empty error reply; callers preferring stricter handling may surface the error instead - in-tree callers left as-is. unprotect_request: canonical-PIV validation, KID == recipient_id + optional kid_context == id_context (NO_CONTEXT), SEQ_EXHAUSTED above OSCORE_SSN_MAX, reserve-then-commit-after-auth replay, NULL size-query mode explicitly documented as removed (strict in/out len params), NULL-buffer-with-content INVALID_PARAM and insufficient capacity BUFFER_TOO_SMALL (krdd wording folded in), zero-caller-bytes. unprotect_response: same treatment (8.3 vs 8.4 nonce selection, fresh-PIV and correlation replay windows, optional-but-must-match KID/kid_context, class 2..5 inner code, removed size-query, NULL vs capacity codes, commit-after-auth). Verified: syntax matrix (clang -fsyntax-only -Wall -Wextra -Wnullability-completeness, all 7 oscore TUs x PT_MAX 256/2048 x MAX_CONTEXTS 8/32) clean; doc statements cross-checked against oscore_protect.c implementation and exercised by the rr/margin host harnesses (real crypto, ASan+UBSan clean). No signature changes, so coap_oscore.c (not stub-compilable here, needs zephyr/net) has no compile exposure; its behavior matches the documented fallback by inspection at :98 (piv_len>0 guard) and :302-316 (unprotected 5.00 fallback).
